import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def task_func(df, x_column, y_column):
    data = df[[x_column, y_column]].copy()

    data[x_column] = pd.to_numeric(data[x_column], errors="coerce")
    data[y_column] = pd.to_numeric(data[y_column], errors="coerce")
    data = data.dropna(subset=[x_column, y_column])

    if len(data) < 2:
        raise ValueError(
            "At least two valid data points are required to fit a linear regression model."
        )

    x = data[[x_column]].to_numpy()
    y = data[y_column].to_numpy()

    model = LinearRegression()
    model.fit(x, y)

    x_line = np.linspace(x.min(), x.max(), 100).reshape(-1, 1)
    y_line = model.predict(x_line)

    ax = plt.gca()
    ax.scatter(data[x_column], data[y_column])
    ax.plot(x_line.ravel(), y_line, color="red")

    return ax
